posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Destruction at 0hp is a constant, passive effect.  It does have a trigger, just like anything changing damage has a trigger.  One-shots are activated when they enter play, the triggering effect is the card entering play.  If it does not enter play the effect does not occur, if it does enter play the effect occurs, the action that causes the effect to happen is called a trigger.

Also, there is no such thing as an effect without a cause.  That's simple metaphysics, there cannot be an effect with no cause.

Also the rulebook does not state that competing effects are resolved by card play order, it states:

In all situations, card effects that happen simultaneously occur in the order in which the cards entered play.

In order to be resolved by card order, it has to be an effect that happens simultaneously.  That's why you resolve damage changes first, they are effects that are resolved simultaneously, thus by card order.  They do not change the wording on cards, they change the damage that a hero is trying to deal to a different type.  Whether you call it a triggered effect or not, it is an effect that changes damage, and they all happen simultaneously when you declare damage being dealt.

Please, someone explain to me why damage mods have to have timing to the effect. We have dev posts in this very thread saying damage modification effects are "static" or in other terms, "always on". There are big implications to saying that. The largest one you all seem to be blissfully ignoring is that if something is "static" or always on, then it is never off or not changing. Meaning there can't be timing to trigger the effect "on" since there was never an "off" position. Which means when resolving all these different effects in game, you must assume that all damage mods are always considered and accounted for first before anything else. Why? All effects within the game are triggered by something. There are no exeptions. Damage mods, if the card is in play and always on, as the devs have said, the damage mod effect has already triggered and is already on by the time Blade Batalion triggers to deal damage to Fixer.

If anyone would like to explain a different interpretation for what "static" means and how that relates to triggered effects within this game, lets hear it. Anything else is house rules at this point.
